''See also: [[Emperor's armor Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor's armor, also known as the Emperor's white armor, is a smooth, white suit of protective plating that resembles large eggshells. The plates are connected at the joints by chainmail, and the entire set is invested to be nearly weightless for the wearer. Historically used by the Emperor during the [[Elder War]], the suit is a significant treasure from his personal [[armory]]. It features a helmet that completely obscures the wearer's face, utilizing darkened glass for a visor so that only dark spaces are visible between the white plates. The armor is characterized by a massive amount of ancient, solid [[Intent]] left behind by the Emperor. This [[Intent]] serves several purposes: it provides world-class protection that can defend a wearer's very essence against attacks, and it carries the Emperor's [[Authority|authority]], which can be felt through the metal. However, this power is so intense that it can overwhelm or nearly lose a wearer in its depths when they attempt to use their senses. While the armor is designed to preserve and protect the life of its wearer, it cannot distinguish between different types of physical trauma, such as surgery versus a wound. In recent events, [[Calder]] has utilized the armor to reinforce his status and provide defense. Although it does not increase physical abilities, its protective qualities are substantial enough to withstand intense heat and heavy attacks. The armor is considered a vital piece of equipment for the [[Imperial Steward]] to ensure their personal safety.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A priceless treasure, the Emperor's white armor is imbued with a complex [[Intent]] to protect and preserve life. While a full set can be seen displayed on a mannequin in the costume gallery, the armor was previously held by the Steward. [[Calder]] utilizes the suit for defense, relying on its protective powers to keep both him and [[Petal]] alive. Although the armor is not designed for swimming, [[Calder]] wears it while going ashore, even as it provides vital protection against [[Elderspawn]] bites. Eventually, the suit crashes down to the deck, falling apart plate by plate.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] was seen wearing the Emperor's armor from the neck down, though it was eventually revealed that the suit he wore was fake. Following this discovery, the [[Champions]] stripped the armor from [[Calder]]'s body. Later, [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] was once again seen wearing the Emperor's armor. During this time, [[Kelarac]] burned plates of the suit directly off [[Calder]]'s person.}}
